summary.name: mlmmj
summary.one_liner: mlmmj is a simple, lightweight mailing list manager inspired by ezmlm that works with many mail transfer agents and requires no daemons.
use_cases: running a mailing list on a small VPS
summary.what_it_does: mlmmj is a mailing list manager inspired by ezmlm. It works with many different MTAs and is designed to be simple to install, configure and integrate with other software. It uses few resources and requires no daemons, which suits small systems such as VPSes. Listed features include archiving, custom headers and footers, automated bounce handling, requeueing, moderation, subject prefixes, subscribers-only posting, regex access control, retrieval of old posts, a web interface, digests, no-mail subscription, VERP support, and DSN (RFC1891) support.
notable: Runs without daemons and uses very few resources
Automated bounce handling similar to ezmlm
caveats: Deliberately omits some features to stay lean
Platform support is not named on the page
